items.text: Masoud Pezeshkian spoke about the killing of students in the war. Morteza Kazemian criticized these remarks and referred to the December killings during Pezeshkian's government. He questioned the ethical legitimacy of such statements.

Alireza Beiranvand must be conscripted for military service on the first of Aban. His medical requests, including shoulder injury and referral to the neurology and psychiatry commission, were reviewed but not approved. The location and manner of his service are not yet determined and will be announced in the coming days.

Yesterday, a minibus carrying seasonal workers collided with a car on the Piranshahr to Mirabad route. This accident resulted in injuries to five workers. More details are published by Harana News Agency.

The Houthis launched a deadly attack on Riyadh International Airport. This issue and escalating tensions in the Middle East are the focus of the EU foreign ministers' meeting in Luxembourg. Iran's developments and maritime security are also discussed in the meeting.
A citizen sent a video showing a protest poster next to an ATM in Zanjan. The poster protests the rise in currency prices. He says our money has no value anymore.

Majid Ibn al-Reza, acting Minister of Defense, warned about the dangers of civilizational confrontation and playing with fire. He emphasized that Iran's armed forces are ready to respond and that the US should not play with fire. Ibn al-Reza stated that a civilizational assault cannot force the Iranian nation to retreat.

The judiciary of the Islamic Republic announced the execution of Omar Dorostaran, a member of the Jaish al-Adl group. He was accused of supporting attacks on military bases in Rask and Chabahar counties in Farvardin 1403. The judiciary did not provide any explanation about the trial proceedings.

Messages received by Iran International indicate worsening living conditions for workers and drivers in various cities. Some have not been paid for several months and their insurance has been cut off. The living crisis has intensified alongside rising currency and essential goods prices.

A 33-year-old young man reports severe economic problems and currency devaluation in Iran. He complains about increased theft and insecurity, high inflation, and the social security's failure to pay unemployment insurance. He also points to rising prices of daily goods and declining purchasing power.

Retired telecommunications workers in Khuzestan held a protest march in Ahvaz today. They demanded the implementation of regulation 89/24 and attention to their demands. The protesters objected to the supplementary insurance situation and the arbitrary increase in insurance premiums.

The Israeli Prime Minister discussed the possibility of a military attack on Iran in a meeting with security officials. The Israeli army is preparing for three scenarios: an independent attack, joint operations with the US, and responding to a potential Iranian attack. More details are available in an interview with an Iran International reporter.

The Judiciary Media Center announced the execution of Omar Dorostaran, a security suspect from Rask county. He was identified as a member of an opposition group against the regime. The execution took place today, Monday, October 12.

Ali Hossein Ghazizadeh spoke about the Islamic Republic's threats against AI centers and US infrastructure in the region. He said these threats may cause costs but do not provide sufficient deterrence to make the US abandon confronting the nuclear program. The US prefers sanctions to take effect in the short term and is not in a hurry for military conflict unless Tehran crosses red lines.

A video shows Arnika Dabag's father visiting her grave on International Day of the Girl. Arnika Dabag, a 15-year-old teenager, was killed on January 9, 2026, in Gorgan. The video was released by Iran International.

Amin Nasser, CEO of Aramco, stated that the global crude oil supply is severely limited and replenishing oil reserves may take up to two years. Aramco is exploring additional export routes and expanding storage capacity. The company also plans to increase gas production capacity by 80% by 2030.

Families of martyrs who lost their daughters during the Iranian national revolution commemorated them on International Day of the Girl. They also spoke about their daughters' bravery in the December protests and continuing their path. This was discussed in an interview with Farnoush Faraji.
A group of retirees gathered in Ahvaz and Kermanshah on Monday, October 12, to protest economic hardships. They chanted slogans against injustice. The protest was held due to living condition issues.

People complain about the difficult economic and social conditions under war, inflation, and rampant price increases. Retired armed forces personnel receive very low pensions, and young people have had to drop out of school to work. The prices of essential goods have risen sharply while their quality has declined.

A Nicaraguan-flagged tanker was attacked by a drone at Sohar anchorage and caught fire. Two of the 11 Indian crew members went missing. India condemned the attacks and is cooperating with Omani authorities to assist the crew.
A 15-year-old Afghan girl and child marriage victim in Mashhad was killed by her 22-year-old husband. The suspect fled after the murder but was later arrested by law enforcement and imprisoned.

The mother of Soda Akramifard said on International Girls' Day that her daughter's wish was for freedom in Iran and the return of Prince Reza Pahlavi. She stated that she will continue her daughter's path. Soda Akramifard, a 16-year-old teenager, was killed on January 9, 2026, in Marlik Malard.

Amnesty International reported that after the killing of protesters in the Woman, Life, Freedom uprising, Iranian authorities harass the families of the victims. This harassment is considered part of crimes against humanity. The Amnesty International report is described as unprecedented.

Masoud Pezeshkian criticized the large bonuses received by managers of state-owned and semi-governmental companies despite heavy losses. He also criticized the interference of various institutions, including the judiciary, in appointments. These remarks were made in an assessment by Arash Azarmi, economic section editor of Iran International.

Philip Luther, the research director of Amnesty International, says the suppression of the families seeking justice in the Women, Life, Freedom uprising has been organized. The Islamic Republic has launched a campaign to intimidate and threaten the families from the beginning.

Following attacks by Houthi forces supported by the Islamic Republic on Saudi Arabia, Al-Nassr team's practice was canceled. Several people were killed and injured in recent attacks on Riyadh airports. Concerns have increased about holding Al-Nassr's match against Neftchi Fergana.

A birthday ceremony for Sarina Saedi, a protester killed in the "Woman, Life, Freedom" uprising, was held at her grave. Sarina Saedi was a 16-year-old teenager who was killed on October 27, 2022, in Sanandaj.
Students at Bu-Ali University in Hamedan protested on Tuesday, October 12, by placing their food trays on the floor. The protest was against food poisoning incidents and poor food quality.

Mohammad Reza Aref, deputy to Masoud Pezeshkian, emphasized that Iran is an ancient civilization that defends its identity. He warned that the science and technology front is advancing rapidly and enemies will receive a stronger response if they make a mistake. He also criticized the dependence of some Islamic countries' rulers on the West.

Nigel Farage announced that if his party wins the 2029 election, granting asylum to all applicants will be banned for five years. New applications will be automatically rejected and applicants will be returned. He also plans to cancel legal resettlement routes for refugees but exempts Ukrainians.

Milad Mohammadi talks about the killing of his brother Shahriar Mohammadi during the Woman, Life, Freedom uprising. He also discusses the security pressures on their family. This interview reveals details about the situation of the families of the victims.

Reza Zangeneh, a death row prisoner in Qezel Hesar prison in Karaj, has been transferred to solitary confinement. He was sentenced to death by the second branch of the Karaj Revolutionary Court on charges of spying for Israel. This news was reported by the HRANA news agency.

Teachers face severe economic pressure and security monitoring at the start of the new school year. Some teachers say their salaries do not cover basic living and commuting expenses. They have resorted to second and third jobs to meet their expenses.

Rouhollah Najabat stated that the war has entered a new phase where the enemy cannot defeat Iran, nor is a fruitless end to the war imaginable. He warned that some internal statements have given the enemy a chance to regroup. He also said the armed forces' strength has led to a strategic defeat of the enemy and a deadlock for Washington.

Esmaeil Baghayi, spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, responded to the controversy surrounding his presence at the Arash orchestral event in Spinas Hall, Tehran. He stated that his quick retorts are directed at enemies, not his compatriots. This reaction came after he was booed by the audience.
